title: 第21章 聚首第22章 数值崩坏
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: 雾觉得，接下来势必要爆发一场相当血腥的搏杀。
坤也是这么觉得的。
毕竟，穿过龙墓盆地的这一路死了三名执事，这笔账肯定会被算在那个死诞者的头上。
另外，找到死诞者的时候发现宁语也在他身边，这也进一步肯定了雾心中的猜想。
而先前执事团领队也说过，让她在找到死诞者之后，带着坤躲远点。
雾也照做了。
她带着坤第一时间在通道上倒退五十米。
觉得不够妥当，又多退了二十米，几乎已经看不见猎龙者的洞窟了。
坤：“姐，我们这样是不是有点反应过激了？而且……”
雾冷冷地瞪了弟弟一眼，但坤还是硬着头皮说出后半句话：
“而且，万一执事团的人打输了，我们躲在这两头堵的地方不也是等死么…”
其实坤说的很有道理，但是无解。
他们只是学徒，关键时刻只能听从指令，而生死，也只能由执事们决定，他们能击败死诞者并将其收服，那么雾和坤才算安全。
“我们没得选。”
雾冷眼望着前方猎龙者洞窟方向的微弱火光，默默地从腰间抽出自己的随身刺剑，攥紧着剑柄。
坤也默默地抽出燧发火枪，将燧石触发装置安装好。
相比于雾坤姐弟俩的严阵以待，猎龙者洞窟里的氛围其实非常轻松。
出现的台词如下：
“该回学院了。”
“好啊。”
前一句是执事团领队说的，后一句是珲伍给出的答复。
他如此干脆利落的回应让原本已经准备好施展雷霆手段的领队感到有些猝不及防。
好啊？
那你之前跑个什么劲儿？
执事团其他成员此刻依旧一言不发地围着珲伍和宁语。
感到有些许糊涂的领队只得再次进行确认：
“不打算反抗？”
珲伍：“快带路吧。”
其实他暗暗腹诽的是，特么世界系统给这些npc优化了之后怎么全都废话连篇的。
实际上刚刚他就是在对话中做出了选择，只要选择不抵抗，就会被执事团以一种相对平和的方式带回密大学院。
如果选择对抗，那就免不了打一架，但最终还是得回去密大学院。
因为，前期剧情的主场就在密大学院，大陆南方几乎所有的大人物都聚集在那个地方，小半个世界线的剧情，都由密大学院在做着决定。
再者珲伍这个死诞者的前身，本就是密大学院的教师。
至少，辛之墓群里的墓碑是这么写的。
跟执事团干这一架的收益几乎为零，因为这些人本质上并不属于敌对势力，即便动手杀了也挣不到多少灵魂，而且还会还会在后续剧情里把学院执事团推向自己的对立面。
属于是给自己接下来要走的剧情增加难度。
所以珲伍选择了同意随行返回学院。
而后随之而来吐槽的就是被世界系统优化之后的npc台词实在有点过于冗杂了。
以前都是，好啊，然后就被领着返回学院了的，哪有这么多无意义的废话。
当然，对于执事团而言，他们的疑惑也非常有理有据。
首先站在他们面前的这个人就不像是死诞者，而更像是一个有裸露癖的邋遢普通人。
content_en:
Wu felt that a rather bloody fight was bound to break out next.
Kun felt the same way.
After all, three deacons died along the way through the Dragon Tomb Basin, and this debt will definitely be placed on the head of the deceased.
In addition, when he found the deceased, he found that Ning Yu was also with him, which further confirmed Wu's suspicion.
The leader of the Deacon Team had previously told her to take Kun and stay away after she found the deceased.
Fog followed suit.
She led Kun back fifty meters in the passage immediately.
Feeling that it was not appropriate enough, he retreated another twenty meters, until the dragon hunter's cave was almost out of sight.
Kun: "Sister, are we overreacting like this? And..."
Wu glared at his brother coldly, but Kun still had the courage to say the second half of the sentence:
"Besides, if the deacons lose the fight, wouldn't we hide in these two blocked areas and wait to die..."
In fact, what Kun said makes sense, but there is no solution.
They are just apprentices and can only follow instructions at critical moments, and life and death can only be decided by the deacons. If they can defeat the Deathborn and subdue them, then Wu and Kun will be considered safe.
"We have no choice."
Wu Leng stared at the faint fire ahead in the direction of the Dragon Hunter's Cave, silently pulled out his own stabbing sword from his waist, and gripped the hilt tightly.
Kun also silently pulled out his flintlock musket and installed the flint trigger device.
Compared to the tense situation of the Wukun siblings, the atmosphere in the Dragon Hunter's Cave was actually very relaxed.
The lines that appear are as follows:
"It's time to go back to the academy."
"Okay."
The former sentence was said by the leader of the deacon team, and the latter sentence was the reply given by Hui Wu.
His crisp response caught the team leader, who was already preparing to use thunderous tactics, a bit off guard.
OK?
Then why were you running so hard before?
The other members of the deacon team still surrounded Hui Wu and Ning Yu without saying a word.
The team leader, who felt a little confused, had to confirm again:
"Don't plan to resist?"
Hui Wu: "Hurry up and lead the way."
In fact, what he secretly complained about was that after the world system was optimized for these NPCs, why were they all talking nonsense?
In fact, he had just made a choice in the dialogue. As long as he chose not to resist, he would be brought back to the University of Michigan in a relatively peaceful manner by the Deacons.
If you choose to fight, you will inevitably have a fight, but you will eventually have to go back to the University of Michigan.
Because the main venue of the early plot is the University of Michigan. Almost all the big shots in the southern part of the mainland are gathered there. The plot of half of the world line is decided by the University of Michigan.
Furthermore, the predecessor of Huiwu, the deceased, was originally a teacher at the University of Michigan.
At least, that's what the tombstones in Xin's Tombs say.
The profit from fighting the deacons is almost zero, because these people are not hostile in nature. Even if they kill them, they will not earn many souls, and they will push the college deacons to oppose them in the subsequent plot.
It is to increase the difficulty of the plot you are going to follow.
So Hui Wu chose to agree to accompany him back to the academy.
What followed was a complaint that the NPC lines after being optimized by the world system were a bit too complicated.
In the past, it was always, OK, and then we were led back to the academy. How could there be so much meaningless nonsense.
Of course, for the deacons, their doubts are also very well-founded.
First of all, the man standing in front of them didn't look like a dead person, but more like a sloppy ordinary person with exhibitionism.
